createDiscordRPC: Create a new Discord Rich Presence session for the given Discord application client ID, and start its background update loop
DiscordRPC.updatePresence: Update the Rich Presence shown on Discord.
DiscordRPC.clearPresence: Clear the currently shown Rich Presence
DiscordRPC.stop: Stop the background update loop and shut down the Discord RPC connection
DiscordRPC.isRunning: Returns true if the background update loop is still running
DiscordRPC.isConnected: Returns true if currently connected to the Discord client
